signals.title: Circle pleit voor flexibelere liquiditeitseisen in MiCA-herziening EU
signals.summary: Circle wants the EU to replace mandatory bank-deposit minimums with more flexible liquidity rules and preserve cross-border stablecoin issuance.

signals.title: Hyperliquid en Circle dienen opmerkingen in over MiCA-regelgeving
signals.summary: Hyperliquid's policy group wants perps under MiFID II, while Circle targets MiCA's bank deposit floor in filings to the European Commission's MiCA review.

signals.title: 50.000 Europeanen vragen EU om stablecoin-beloningen in MiCA soepeler in te stellen
signals.summary: A 50,000-letter campaign is pressing Brussels to rethink stablecoin rewards as EU central banks seek broader changes to MiCA’s stablecoin rules.

signals.title: Europese Commissie wil MiCA uitbreiden voor tokenisering en niet-EU stablecoin-emittenten
signals.summary: The European Commission is reportedly seeking comment from stakeholders on expanding MiCA rules until Sept. 30.

signals.title: Besluiten van de Raad van Bestuur van de ECB naast beleidsrentebesluitingen
signals.summary: Decisions taken by the Governing Council of the ECB (in addition to decisions setting interest rates)

signals.title: ECB en EU centrale banken willen MiCA-depositorequirements voor stablecoins aanpassen
signals.summary: The ECB and EU central banks want to replace MiCA’s stablecoin bank-deposit requirements with liquidity thresholds, warning that sudden withdrawals could strain lenders.

signals.title: EBA publiceert ontwerpmethodologie voor boeterollen onder MiCA
signals.summary: ​The European Banking Authority (EBA) published today a Consultation Paper with a draft methodology for setting fines in its role as supervisor under MiCA. The objective is to ensure that fines imposed on issuers of significant crypto-assets are consistent, proportionate and transparent, and effectively support compliance with the regulatory framework.

signals.title: EU-emittenten pleiten voor dollar stablecoins naast euro-variant
signals.summary: European issuers say Europe cannot ignore demand for dollar stablecoins as businesses seek USD liquidity for global payments and settlement.
